finding_info_list.title: Posture alert det-eb-001: acme-internal-exports in acme-prod made publicly readable
finding_info_list.desc:
Opened by: cloud posture automation.

Summary: posture alert det-eb-001 reported at 09:40 UTC that the bucket policy on acme-internal-exports (account 111122223333, us-east-1) grants s3:GetObject to any principal. The policy change was a PutBucketPolicy call at 09:28 UTC made with the deploy-ci access key (AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE) from 203.0.113.77. No change request is linked to the change.

Requested of Tier 2: establish whether the change was a planned pipeline change; if not, contain the principal and the source address, restore the bucket's access controls and hand off to IR.
